name: Goi ca chich
summary: A small freshwater fish, fried whole and rolled in a phở sheet with herbs and cucumber, or served raw as a salad once the bones are out.
origin: Quy Nhon. The fish lives in rivers, lakes, ponds, and streams.
howToEat: Roll the fried fish in the phở sheet with herbs and cucumber, or order the raw salad.
seoTitle: Goi ca chich — Quy Nhon freshwater fish
seoDescription: Gỏi cá chích is a small freshwater fish, fried whole in a phở sheet with herbs, or served raw once the bones are out, in Quy Nhon.
